qa_pair.question: Inspect the default ECS configuration. Which three system phases are supported? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect ECS capabilities and runtime evidence. Which portable storage layout is used for baked entities?
Inspect the strict ECS authoring contract. Which two values guard every configuration mutation against stale external writes?
Inspect ECS field schemas. Which four vector-like field types are supported? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect ECS baking behavior. Does an incremental bake preserve unchanged chunk object identity while rebuilding affected archetype buckets? Respond True or False.
Inspect ECS section behavior. What is the stable id of the built-in section that cannot be deleted?
Inspect ECS runtime commands. Are queued structural changes published atomically only after every command validates? Respond True or False.
Inspect ECS execution settings. Which three execution modes are supported? Answer as a comma-separated list in reported order.
Inspect ECS compilation documentation and tool descriptions. Does the portable kernel claim Unity Burst LLVM or native binary identity? Respond True or False.
Inspect destructive ECS tool schemas. Is literal confirmation required before deleting the configuration, component types, fields, systems, sections, or runtime entities? Respond True or False.
